subject: Weekly exec heatmap: decisions, holdovers, and QBR asks
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly exec heatmap: decisions, holdovers, and QBR asks

Team —

Attached is a compact heatmap for this week that pulls together wins, active risks, and explicit asks for the QBR packet. I kept it intentionally short; bolded lines are the items I think need a decision at the exec table next Tuesday. High level:

- Wins: Dedicated capacity latency target met (p95 < 65ms) for customer-facing models; early savings from new batching config (estimated $35k/mo).
- Risks: One SOC2 evidence item (tokenization logs) still pending; VelvetHQ procurement timeline wants a final SLA exception by Friday.
- Asks: Approve the QBR action grid rows marked "decision required" (rows 2, 5, 7) and ack the suggested fallback for region routing.

I've left comments inline in QBR_Action_Grid.xlsx (attached) for the items that require sign-off. If you want a 15-min run-through before the exec sync, I'm available at 10:30 or 3:30 PT.

Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Customer Success & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- QBR_Action_Grid.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- SOC2_Evidence_Digest.pdf (doc summary)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly exec heatmap: decisions, holdovers, and QBR asks

Thanks, Sergio — good concise pack. A couple quick notes:

- Row 2 (VelvetHQ SLA exception): I am +1 to grant a limited SLA exception (30 days) provided procurement signs our updated DPA and we get the promised connectivity test by end of week.
- Row 5 (Dedicated autoscale change): Jonas, can your team confirm the rollback plan window and the cost delta if we need to revert? I don't want a surprise spike.
- Row 7 (Regional fallback): Marissa, is the fallback automatic or manual? If automatic, need a knob to disable for a small subset of traffic during the test.

I'll join the 3:30 run-through. If anyone needs the earlier slot, ping me.

--Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly exec heatmap: decisions, holdovers, and QBR asks

Laura / team — quick updates from infra: 

- Rollback plan for autoscale change (row 5): we have a scripted rollback that restores previous batch/slot sizes within 90s; cost delta estimate if we revert is +12% on GPU spend for affected clusters (~$28k/mo) — included in the spreadsheet comments.
- Regional fallback: current plan is automatic with traffic-shift windowed to 5m; Marissa and I discussed adding a feature-flag knob to pin test traffic (manual override). We'll have a flag by EOD.
- SOC2 evidence for tokenization logs: engineering needs another API key from VelvetHQ to pull historical logs. Sergio, can you confirm procurement will provide the key by Thursday? Without it we miss the evidence cutoff for the auditor.

I'll be on the 3:30 PT slot.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Chen <alicia.chen@velvethq.com>, procurement@velvethq.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly exec heatmap: decisions, holdovers, and QBR asks

Alicia / VelvetHQ procurement — thanks for the call earlier. Quick follow-ups: 

1) Can you confirm the API key delivery timeline so our engineering team can fetch tokenization logs for the SOC2 package? We need the key by Thursday EOD PT to hit internal audit deadlines.
2) On the SLA exception: Laura (cc'd) has agreed to a 30-day limited exception conditioned on the signed DPA and the connectivity test. Please share the procurement redlines and the earliest date you can run the connectivity test (recommended: this Friday).

I'll attach the QBR action grid in our signature again. Thanks for moving quickly on this — it keeps us on track for next week's exec packet.

Best,
Sergio
Director, Customer Success & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment references: QBR_Action_Grid.xlsx (rows highlighted: 2,5,7)
